name: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES)

flags.claim: Explosion of formulaic research articles, including inappropriate study designs and false discoveries, based on the NHANES US national health database.

source.title: Explosion of formulaic research articles, including inappropriate study designs and false discoveries, based on the NHANES US national health database
source.authors: Suchak T, Aliu AE, Harrison C, Zwiggelaar R, Geifman N, Spick M

downstream_impact.note: Publisher policy responses: PLOS retrospective health-database editorial policy update (2025-09), Frontiers fast-churn policy (2025-09-15), individual policies at Scientific Reports and others.

notes: IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: the dataset's authenticity is NOT in question — it is a CDC-operated national survey and the source of record. The flag concerns a misuse pattern (mass formulaic secondary research with false discoveries), a different failure mode from unverifiable provenance. Do not read this row as 'the data is fake'.
